title: One-pot fabrication of a novel urchin-like Fe3O4/α-FeOOH/Al(OH)3 magnetic nanocomposite for phosphate removal and recovery: adsorption performance and mechanism
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,29611-29623
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01891B, Paper

A novel urchin-like Fe3O4/α-FeOOH/Al(OH)3 (MGA) nanocomposite was synthesized via a facile one-pot strategy for phosphate adsorption and recovery.
